f3_program: observe(at("rodney.commission_per_system", "current"), 25, "dollar_per_system", source("a commission of $25 for each system he sells"))
collection("neighborhood.streets", "street", "neighborhood", source("a neighborhood of four streets with eight houses each"))
observe(at("neighborhood.streets.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("four streets"))
observe(at("neighborhood.houses_per_street.count", "current"), 8, "count", source("eight houses each"))

fraction_of(at("rodney.systems_sold.first_street.count", "current"), at("rodney.systems_sold.second_street.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("The first street gave him half the sales that the second street did"))
observe(at("rodney.systems_sold.third_street.count", "current"), 0, "count", source("every house on the third street turned him away"))
observe(at("rodney.systems_sold.fourth_street.count", "current"), 1, "count", source("the fourth street resulted in only one sale"))
observe(at("rodney.total_commission", "current"), 175, "dollar", source("His total commission was $175"))

rate_relation(at("rodney.total_commission", "current"), at("rodney.commission_per_system", "current"), at("rodney.systems_sold.total.count", "current"), source("He gets a commission of $25 for each system he sells"))

sum_relation(at("rodney.systems_sold.total.count", "current"), at("rodney.systems_sold.first_street.count", "current"), at("rodney.systems_sold.second_street.count", "current"), at("rodney.systems_sold.third_street.count", "current"), at("rodney.systems_sold.fourth_street.count", "current"), source("He is canvassing a neighborhood of four streets with eight houses each. The first street gave him half the sales that the second street did, while every house on the third street turned him away and the fourth street resulted in only one sale"))
query("value", at("rodney.systems_sold.second_street.count", "current"))
collection("trees.growth_amounts", "tree_growth_amount", "trees", source("There are four growing trees"))
observe(at("trees.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("four growing trees"))
member("trees.growth_amounts", "trees.first.growth.amount", source("The first tree grows 1 meter/day"))
member("trees.growth_amounts", "trees.second.growth.amount", source("the second grows the same amount in half the time"))
member("trees.growth_amounts", "trees.third.growth.amount", source("the third grows 2 meters/day"))
member("trees.growth_amounts", "trees.fourth.growth.amount", source("the fourth tree grows a meter more than the third each day"))
observe(at("trees.first.growth.rate", "current"), 1, "meter_per_day", source("The first tree grows 1 meter/day"))
same(at("trees.second.growth.amount", "comparison_interval"), at("trees.first.growth.amount", "comparison_interval"), source("the second grows the same amount"))
fraction_of(at("trees.second.growth.duration", "comparison_interval"), at("trees.first.growth.duration", "comparison_interval"), 1, 2, source("half the time"))

rate_relation(at("trees.first.growth.amount", "comparison_interval"), at("trees.first.growth.rate", "current"), at("trees.first.growth.duration", "comparison_interval"), source("The first tree grows 1 meter/day"))

rate_relation(at("trees.second.growth.amount", "comparison_interval"), at("trees.second.growth.rate", "current"), at("trees.second.growth.duration", "comparison_interval"), source("the second grows the same amount in half the time"))
observe(at("trees.third.growth.rate", "current"), 2, "meter_per_day", source("the third grows 2 meters/day"))
offset(at("trees.fourth.growth.rate", "current"), at("trees.third.growth.rate", "current"), 1, "meter_per_day", source("the fourth tree grows a meter more than the third each day"))
observe(at("trees.growth.duration", "4_days"), 4, "day", source("in 4 days"))
rate_relation(at("trees.first.growth.amount", "4_days"), at("trees.first.growth.rate", "current"), at("trees.growth.duration", "4_days"), source("The first tree grows 1 meter/day"))

rate_relation(at("trees.second.growth.amount", "4_days"), at("trees.second.growth.rate", "current"), at("trees.growth.duration", "4_days"), source("the second grows the same amount in half the time"))
rate_relation(at("trees.third.growth.amount", "4_days"), at("trees.third.growth.rate", "current"), at("trees.growth.duration", "4_days"), source("the third grows 2 meters/day"))

rate_relation(at("trees.fourth.growth.amount", "4_days"), at("trees.fourth.growth.rate", "current"), at("trees.growth.duration", "4_days"), source("the fourth tree grows a meter more than the third each day"))
query("sum", "trees.growth_amounts", "4_days")
observe(at("new_video_game.cost", "current"), 60, "dollar", source("costs $60"))
collection("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish", "fish", "bucky", source("He caught five fish this Sunday"))
observe(at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.count", "this_sunday"), 5, "count", source("He caught five fish this Sunday"))
collection("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.species_groups", "fish_species_group", "bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish", source("60% were trout, and the rest were blue-gill"))
member("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.species_groups", "bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout", source("60% were trout"))
member("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.species_groups", "bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.blue_gill", source("the rest were blue-gill"))
percent_of(at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout.count", "this_sunday"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.count", "this_sunday"), 60, source("60% were trout"))

sum_relation(at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.count", "this_sunday"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout.count", "this_sunday"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.blue_gill.count", "this_sunday"), source("60% were trout, and the rest were blue-gill"))
observe(at("bucky.trout.earnings_per_fish", "current"), 5, "dollar_per_fish", source("$5 from trout"))
observe(at("bucky.blue_gill.earnings_per_fish", "current"), 4, "dollar_per_fish", source("$4 from blue-gill"))

rate_relation(at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout.earnings", "this_sunday"), at("bucky.trout.earnings_per_fish", "current"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout.count", "this_sunday"), source("He can earn $5 from trout"))

rate_relation(at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.blue_gill.earnings", "this_sunday"), at("bucky.blue_gill.earnings_per_fish", "current"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.blue_gill.count", "this_sunday"), source("$4 from blue-gill"))
produce("last_weekend_earnings", "bucky", at("bucky.fish_sale_earnings.amount", "current"), 35, source("Last weekend he earned $35"))

produce("this_sunday_trout_earnings", "bucky", at("bucky.fish_sale_earnings.amount", "current"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout.earnings", "this_sunday"), source("Bucky earns money each weekend catching and selling fish"))

produce("this_sunday_blue_gill_earnings", "bucky", at("bucky.fish_sale_earnings.amount", "current"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.blue_gill.earnings", "this_sunday"), source("Bucky earns money each weekend catching and selling fish"))
query("difference", at("bucky.fish_sale_earnings.amount", "current"), at("new_video_game.cost", "current"))
